exercises.question: Which sentence gives a reason for the unexpected excursion?
options: La excursión ha sido inesperada porque ha llovido.
La excursión ha sido inesperada, por eso ha llovido.
La excursión ha sido inesperada porque ha llover.

exercises.sentence: La excursión ha sido inesperada __ ha llovido.
exercises.english: The excursion has been unexpected because it has rained.
The route has changed, so we have seen another landscape.

exercises.question: Which sentence shows a consequence?
options: Nos hemos mojado, por eso hemos vuelto.
Hemos vuelto porque nos hemos mojado.
Nos hemos mojado, por eso hemos volver.

exercises.sentence: Ha cambiado la ruta, __ hemos visto otro paisaje.
exercises.english: The route has changed, so we have seen another landscape.
I think it has been fun.

exercises.question: Which sentence gives an opinion about the excursion?
options: Pienso que ha sido divertido.
Ha llovido, por eso hemos vuelto.
Hemos vuelto porque nos hemos mojado.

pairs: por eso hemos visto otro paisaje
that is why we have seen another landscape
